name: switch
title: Switch
description: Binary on/off control with immediate-effect semantics. A visually-hidden native input[role=switch] carries focus, keyboard activation (Space toggles) and form value; a presentational pill track + sliding thumb provide the visuals. sm/md/lg sizes (token-driven), left/right label position, optional hint, and error state with aria-invalid + aria-describedby wiring. Controlled-first via checked + onCheckedChange (detail {checked, value}), with defaultChecked uncontrolled fallback.
